subject: Question about bayes inference in binomial model.

messages.author: e85705aa19e436ef
messages.subject: Question about bayes inference in binomial model.
parts:
Hi guys,
               I am an fresh man to learn the bayes inference by using INLA method. Recently, i was puzzled by the posterior parameters which were in my binomial model. My purpose is inferncing the difference of response variate in different regions, and my response variate contains two outcome(happend=1, not happen =0), and i want see what will happen if i make the outcome "1" in one region and other regions were "0". 

Below is my function:
      
 formula <- y~-1 + Intercept + (my covariates)+ f(spatial, model=spde) + f(region, model="iid")

I don`t understand the result of posterior parameters, which i put in posterior.csv file.

My question is why there are significant results besides the outcome "1"?

How can i describe this result?

 Can someone give me some suggestions? I would grateful to  your reply.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Question about bayes inference in binomial model.
parts:
it seems like you have some kind of confounding in the model, as the
marginal stdev are very large (for the file you attached). maybe there
are terms in your model you do not need.

H

parts:
with small sample size, you have to be carefull about the priors. we
generally recommend using penalized complexity priors, and those
implemented in INLA are,

> inla.list.models(section="prior")
Section [prior]
pc Generic PC
prior
pc.alphaw PC prior for alpha in
Weibull
pc.ar PC prior for the AR(p)
model
pc.cor0 PC prior correlation, basemodel
cor=0
pc.cor1 PC prior correlation, basemodel
cor=1
pc.dof PC prior for log(dof-
2)
pc.fgnh PC prior for the Hurst parameter in
FGN
pc.gamma PC prior for a Gamma
parameter
pc.gammacount PC prior for the GammaCount
likelihood
pc.gevtail PC prior for the tail in the GEV
likelihood
pc.matern PC prior for the Matern
SPDE
pc.mgamma PC prior for a Gamma
parameter
pc.prec PC prior for
log(precision)
pc.range PC prior for the range in the
Matern SPDE
pc.sn PC prior for the skew-
normal
pc.spde.GA (experimental)
